t: About – QCBB.ORG
s: The Queen City Brass Band (QCBB), was established in 1992 and recently celebrated our 29th year. The band is a community-based organization that promotes music in a traditional British brass band style and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina. The brass band movement grew up from the industrial revolution in Great Britain and consists entirely of brass instruments with a percussion section.
